categories.name: Classic Uzbekistan Packages
categories.description: Short, well-paced holidays built around Tashkent, a day in Samarkand and the nearby Tian Shan foothills. A comfortable first introduction to Uzbekistan.

categories.name: Silk Road Cities and Heritage
categories.description: Walk through the great Silk Road cities, from the tiled domes of Samarkand to the old trading quarters of Bukhara and the walled town of Khiva.

categories.name: Mountains, Lakes and Amirsoy
categories.description: Chairlifts at Chimgan, turquoise Charvak Lake and the Amirsoy mountain resort, all within reach of Tashkent. Good for families and anyone who likes fresh mountain air.

categories.name: Seasonal Specials: Winter and Autumn
categories.description: Packages timed for the cooler months, when the mountains turn snowy or golden and the sightseeing is comfortable.

categories.name: Multi-Country Combos
categories.description: Pair Uzbekistan with its Central Asian neighbour. Almaty's mountains and canyons, followed by Tashkent, Charvak and Samarkand.

categories.name: Fixed Departure Group Trips
categories.description: Escorted small-group departures on fixed dates with a trip captain throughout. Meet fellow travellers and leave the planning to us.

categories.name: Romantic Escapes
categories.description: Unhurried itineraries for couples, mixing mountain scenery, lakeside time and the lovely tilework of Samarkand.

group_trips.title: Silk Road Cities: Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva Group Trip
group_trips.summary: An escorted nine-day journey through Uzbekistan's four great Silk Road cities, with Tashkent, Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva on fixed departure dates.
group_trips.overview:
This group trip follows the old Silk Road through Uzbekistan's most storied cities. You begin in Tashkent, then travel by high-speed train to Samarkand for Registan Square, Gur-e-Amir and Shah-i-Zinda. From there you continue to Bukhara, with its old trading quarter, minarets and madrasahs.

After a long scenic drive across the desert region, you reach Khiva and its walled inner city, Itchan Kala. A domestic flight returns you to Tashkent for a final night before your flight home.

A trip captain travels with the group throughout, so you can focus on the sights. Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Registan Square, Gur-e-Amir Mausoleum and Shah-i-Zinda in Samarkand
Afrosiyob high-speed train between Tashkent, Samarkand and Bukhara
Bukhara's Kalyan Minaret, Ark Fortress and Lyab-i-Hauz pond
Walled inner city of Itchan Kala in Khiva
Ulugh Beg Observatory and Bibi-Khanym Mosque
Scenic drive across the Kyzylkum desert region
Trip captain with the group and Indian meal options on request

itinerary.description:

See its minarets, mosques and old palaces on a guided walk.
Enjoy free time on the city walls and in the bazaars at sunset.

group_trips.title: Tashkent, Samarkand and Amirsoy Mountains Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A six-day escorted group trip combining Tashkent's landmarks, a full day in Samarkand and a day in the Amirsoy and Charvak mountains.
group_trips.overview:
This escorted departure mixes city culture with mountain air. You explore Tashkent, then take the Afrosiyob train to Samarkand for Registan Square, Gur-e-Amir and a night in the Silk Road city.
